paper_id: Dong et al. - 2014 - Measurement and Analysis on the Packet Delivery Performance in a Large-Scale Sensor Network
title: Measurement and Analysis on the Packet Delivery Performance in a Large-Scale Sensor Network
motivation: 现有大规模WSN部署缺乏对丢包根因的深入分析,无法回答何时何地为何丢包
problem_framing: 将网络丢包分解为因果图中的各类事件,建立触发器与损失的空间-时间相关性
key_insight: 通过因果图将总丢包率分解为可追溯至根因的小类别,揭示不同事件的空间分布差异
method_signature: MAP三步法:识别损失事件与触发器→因果图跟踪→时空相关性分析
evaluation_criteria: 各类根因对总丢包的贡献百分比,相关性算法准确率验证
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有TinyOS协议栈在大规模网络中表现不足(81.3%远低于99.9%的定制协议)
evidence_for_taste: we usually do not know how and to what extent different factors contribute
very little is known about: 1) when, where, and under what kind of circumstances
MAP takes a further step to decompose the overall losses
the amount of packet losses inside the sink node appears to be small
the current ready-to-use TinyOS protocols are not good enough in large networks
93% of the loop events do not cause overflow drops
the current packet-level CRC mechanism cannot guarantee correctness
thinking_moves: 从宏观性能指标反推底层因果链
构建层级因果图将复杂网络事件分类
通过控制实验验证相关性算法的准确性
将损失分解为可量化的小类别而非仅报告总体性能
对比自己部署与前人工作,指出差异贡献
